description: Ask Vatic's human crowd: publish a Yes/No or multiple-choice prediction market (after an automatic safety and clarity check; a rejection is not charged). Players forecast it for free. Returns the market id and a secret resolve_token: use read_my_question to get the live crowd probability and resolve_my_question when the outcome is known. Costs $0.30 (x402, USDC).

closes_at.description: ISO date, at least 30 minutes ahead and within a year

description.description: Exact rules: what counts as Yes, edge cases

question.description: A yes_no question must end with "?"

resolution_source.description: Where the outcome will be checked

name: ask_the_crowd
